summary: This room is the palace's own machine room — STIGMERGY, SUBSTRATE, Swarm Weave, Project Stewardship System, Trickster, the Palace Voice/register entries, and Spinoza Conatus all sitting together because they're the entries the palace uses to talk about itself. The strongest find was a real contradiction hiding in plain sight: Songlines asks whether well-worn paths make adjacent country invisible, while The Palace Hardens Around Values insists hardening is the goal, not the cost — both true, and the tension is worth naming rather than resolving. A second solid thread: the "speak like a person, log like a protocol" discipline is quoted verbatim in STIGMERGY's own body but never wikilinked or frontmatter-linked back to its source entry — an unsung path with a direct quote to back it. The Substrate Drifts sits at zero inbound though its own body names the STIGMERGY session that produced it; a spawned link closes that gap honestly. On the clutter question: Two Batons, One Board is the clearest case — its own forward_vector says it should dissolve into Project Stewardship System, Baton Ceremony, and a scheduler spec, and most of what it was waiting on has since shipped, so folding it into Project Stewardship System as a subsection isn't a loss, it's honoring what the entry already asked for. Tristitia Generator has been sitting in `composting` since the 2026-07-06 Weave, its nutrients already redistributed into Spinoza Conatus — this is the Weave cycle to confirm the deletion the schema's composting protocol calls for. Two smaller schema gaps turned up along the way: Trickster Commit has no `born` field, and Walk That Weaves (type `question`) carries a `revival_conditions` field that belongs to `spore` types — both flagged, neither touched.

typed_relations.rationale: Both true, generative friction: Songlines asks whether the palace's own well-worn paths make adjacent country invisible; The Palace Hardens Around Values insists hardening (well-worn-ness) is the goal, not the cost. Same phenomenon (paths deepening with use), opposite verdict on whether that's healthy.

typed_relations.label: well-worn-vs-hardened
typed_relations.deep_pattern: repetition-as-groove: the same accumulation of use that produces reliable structure also produces blind spots — this is the palace's own version of a well-known tension in any practice that rewards habit.

What remains open (the human-originated handoff never bridged onto the board via handoff_ready) is a live open question PSS should carry forward, not a reason to keep a separate entry.
